title: Model Profile Registry
description: Schema for Vibe Coding OS model-aware configuration. Defines model capabilities, task-to-quality-pack defaults, context limits, and recommended quality profiles.

modelProfiles.description: Record of model profile objects keyed by model_id

modelProfile.description: Defines a single model with provider metadata, capabilities, quality pack recommendations, and token limits.

model_id.description: Unique model identifier used in config references, matching the registry key.

vendor.description: Vendor or provider name such as anthropic, openai, google, deepseek, meta, or nous-research.

capabilities.description: Supported model capabilities used for model-aware task routing and quality selection.

quality_config.description: Mapping from task type to the default quality pack id for this model.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output token budget recommended for this model.

context_window.description: Total model context window in tokens.

recommended_profile.description: Recommended quality engine profile for typical use with this model.
